rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a scheduled period of time.

example.english: We have no class during this time slot, so we can meet for dinner.
example.traditional: 呢個時段我哋冇堂，可以約食飯。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 si4 dyun6 ngo5 dei6 mou5 tong4 ho2 ji5 joek3 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this for a physical slot that receives or holds something, including a hardware memory slot.

example.english: This memory card needs to go into this slot.
example.traditional: 呢張記憶卡要插入呢個插槽。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 gei3 jik1 kaa1 jiu3 caap3 jap6 ni1 go3 caap3 cou4

rows.note: Use this for an abstract storage or save slot, especially in software and games rather than a physical connector.

example.english: This game has a slot specifically for saving its progress.
example.traditional: 呢個遊戲有一個儲存位，專門儲存呢個遊戲嘅進度。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau4 hei3 jau5 jat1 go3 cyu5 cyun4 wai2 zyun1 mun4 cyu5 cyun4 ni1 go3 jau4 hei3 ge3 zeon3 dou6

rows.note: Use this specifically for an airport-allocated aircraft arrival or departure period.

example.english: This airport's takeoff-and-landing slot is tight, so even a slight delay won't do.
example.traditional: 呢個機場嘅起降時段好緊，班機遲少少都唔得。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gei1 coeng4 ge3 hei2 gong3 si4 dyun6 hou2 gan2 baan1 gei1 ci4 siu2 siu2 dou1 m4 dak1
